listing.prompt: A tribute to the 1984 bouncing-ball demo: a red and white checkered sphere spinning as it bounces across a purple perspective grid, a soft shadow on the back wall, the bounce kicked by the bass; anyone can give the ball an extra kick. Build it with a demoscener's economy: one core technique done well, lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
